dimensions.name: Stakeholder Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: The FAQ includes hard questions from at least three stakeholder perspectives: engineering, business/leadership, and legal/compliance when applicable.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more stakeholder perspectives are absent or represented only by softball questions.

dimensions.name: Answer Completeness
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question has either a substantive answer or is explicitly marked [OPEN - owner: X] with a named owner.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more questions are unanswered without [OPEN] marking, or open items have no named owner.

dimensions.name: Blocker Identification
dimensions.pass_criteria: Any open item that would prevent the build from proceeding is flagged as [BLOCKER - owner: X].
dimensions.fail_criteria: Build-blocking issues are buried in [OPEN] items without distinction or are not surfaced.

dimensions.name: No Evasive Answers
dimensions.pass_criteria: Answers to hard questions are direct. Unknowns are marked [OPEN] rather than obscured with confident-sounding language.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Hard questions receive vague, aspirational, or deflecting answers rather than honest responses or [OPEN] flags.
